summary: Added the Dino Lab hero motion to TARZ0-777 without changing the copy. The sky now has drifting pink, blue, yellow, and white pixel clouds, a spinning green bloom, and swaying flowers. A green pixel dinosaur rolls in on a pink skateboard with a rawr tap-me bubble, bobs, spins its wheels, and kickflips on click. Headline letters pop in and turn pink on hover. Verified the kickflip in the browser on localhost:5173.
current_status: TARZ0-777 remains a Vite/React catalog of 145 browser games. The hero now includes the colorful animated sky and tappable skateboarding dinosaur. Logo, play links, and X credit are unchanged.
